<thought>We need to search the template catalog for a Diels‑Alder retrosynthetic transformation. The tool requires at least one criteria list, so we provide an empty list for functional_groups_broken (no filtering). This will return a set of templates applicable to the target molecule. We will then test each template for a match.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{"molecule_smiles":"COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O","functional_groups_broken":[],"limit":20}</action_input>
